description: A dusk into a dark cellar that other cameras light with IR: the day pipeline settles at 4179 and switches to night on night_gain 4096; the night pipeline reads 1000 with the illuminator and 1360 without it (r=1.36). The night was proven by the exposure rule and the lit level is no brighter than the reference anchored after it, so every probe now stays night: two switches (boot measurement, dusk).
